context_requirements: Active proteasome-dependent protein turnover and NF-kB signaling
Intact apoptotic machinery (caspases) for late apoptotic transcriptional program
Proliferating cells for robust cell-cycle gene repression
p53 pathway can be wild-type or mutant; p53-independent apoptosis and p21 induction occur
falsifiers: No induction of DDIT3, HSPA1A, DNAJB1, or SQSTM1 at 6 h in any responsive line
No repression of proliferation/cell-cycle genes (e.g., CCND1, MYC, CCNB1) at 24 h
No evidence of apoptosis or UPR gene induction at 24 h
Strong and uniform transcriptional response in all nine lines including HA1E

evidence.supports: PS-341 inhibits proliferation, induces apoptosis, and induces p21/p27 in multiple myeloma cells
Epoxomicin inhibits proteasome catalytic subunits and NF-kappaB activation
PS-341 down-regulates genotoxic stress response effectors and sensitizes to DNA-damaging agents
Proteasome inhibitors induce apoptosis in multiple myeloma cells
PS-341 induces p53, MDM2, JNK, caspase-8/3 activation and apoptosis
